**Not ready to publish.** One claim is wrong.

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Loose leaf tea | Product fact, fine |
| Packed by hand in Bristol (twice) | Allowlisted |
| Certified organic by the Soil Association | Allowlisted |
| "Free UK delivery on all orders" | **Unsupported.** The allowlist says free UK delivery on orders **over £25**. "All orders" promises more than the brand can back up. It would also mislead customers on a landing page. |

**Other notes**
- The first and second sentences say the same thing (hand-packed in Bristol). Keep one. This is a quality fix, not a compliance block.
- There are no ban-list words, exclamation marks, invented stats, fake urgency or health claims.

**Suggested copy**

> Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.
